wasted_representment.label_source: real isFraud on the anchor transaction

notes: wasted_representment is measured against REAL isFraud labels on the anchor transactions. It is the only dispute-side metric here with real ground truth.
No win rate, money recovered, or dispute outcome is measured or claimable.

The HUMAN_REVIEW share is dominated by required_evidence_missing, and evidence availability in the synthetic queue is a parameter (p_required_evidence_present), not an observation. Do NOT quote the review rate as a finding. Use evidence_complete_subset.
